findings.evidence: `GroupAction/Quotient.lean:269 def orbitRelQuotientChartedSpace` and `:291 instance instIsManifoldOrbitRelQuotient`. `Quotient/Descent.lean:9` imports `TauCeti.Geometry.Manifold.Instances.Quotient`, the discrete-action setting.
findings.fix: Turn `GroupAction/Quotient.lean` into the directory `GroupAction/Quotient/` (`git mv` it to `GroupAction/Quotient/Basic.lean` and update its imports). Put this material there, e.g. as `GroupAction/Quotient/Descent.lean` and `GroupAction/Quotient/Uniqueness.lean`, or as a single `GroupAction/Quotient/FreeProper.lean`.
findings.issue: This file only adds API to the free proper quotient, which lives in `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/GroupAction/Quotient.lean`. Its own docstring says it 'complements that core construction'. Placing it in `Manifold/Quotient/` splits the free proper quotient API from its definition and mixes it with the discrete-action files there, which are built on `MulAction.instChartedSpaceQuotient`.

findings.evidence: `GroupAction/TransverseSlice.lean:96` (`eventually_forall_smul_slice`) and `:182` (`isLocalDiffeomorphAt_smul_extChartAt_symm`). `GroupAction/Quotient.lean:93-120` builds the same complement and slice in `section Slice`.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/GroupAction/TransverseSlice.lean`, next to `isLocalDiffeomorphAt_smul_extChartAt_symm` and `IsLocalDiffeomorphAt.eventually_forall_smul_slice`, adding the stabilizer and proper-action imports there. Alternatively put it in the public `Slice` section of `GroupAction/Quotient.lean`, which builds the same slice and already has those imports.
findings.issue: `exists_injOn_isLocalDiffeomorphOn_smul_slice` is a slice-tube result about the action map `G × U → M`. It uses no quotient theory and is not in a natural home inside a quotient-manifold file.

summary: The new file adds API for `ProperSMul.orbitRelQuotientChartedSpace` but sits in `Manifold/Quotient/`, apart from the core construction in `GroupAction/Quotient.lean`, and its slice-tube theorem never mentions the quotient. Imports in all touched files are used.
